item.title: [No Priors] Why Diffusion Will Win AI Inference with Inception Co-Founder and CEO Stefano Ermon
item.description:
Speaker 1 | 00:05 - 00:31 Hi, listeners. Welcome back to No Priors. Today, I'm here with Stefano Erman, who is a longtime Stanford professor and now co founder and CEO of Inception. Stefano has a extraordinarily broad body of work around generative modeling, but is especially well known as one of the fathers of diffusion. We talk about his company challenging the large labs and why speed and efficiency are going to be the name of the game in AI over the next few years.
